_note: Pacing + rewards. Trip thresholds scale with the number of houses so the rhythm stays steady as traffic grows: next = trips now + max(min, houses x tripsPerHouse). Flip a special's "enabled" to true once it is built.

specials.name: Bridge
specials.description: Drag a road across water. One bridge spans any straight gap.

specials.name: One-way streets
specials.description: Unlocks a toolbar toggle: drag along a road to make it one-way.

specials.name: Roundabout
specials.description: Replaces an intersection with a circle. Keeps heavy traffic flowing.

specials.name: Traffic light
specials.description: Fixed-timer signal for an intersection. Needs a tile of gap between lights.

specials.name: Highway
specials.description: Ten 4-lane road pieces: faster, and room for two lanes each way. Tap its pill to build with it.

specials.name: Tunnel
specials.description: Drag a road straight through a hill. One tunnel covers any length.

specials.name: Overpass
specials.description: Lets a highway cross a street without joining it. Place it on a highway crossing a street.
